title: release.yml feeds vars.REGISTRY_WINDOW_SECONDS into arithmetic unvalidated in its post-publish visibility wait
description:
Found by the LCLI-629 reviewer (2026-09-28): a fourth reader of the registry window. .github/workflows/release.yml sets REGISTRY_WINDOW_SECONDS from the repository variable (vars.REGISTRY_WINDOW_SECONDS, falling back to 1800) at line 1299 and uses it at line 1333 as deadline=$(( started + REGISTRY_WINDOW_SECONDS )), with no check. LCLI-629 made scripts/publish-release.sh refuse anything outside ^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,8})$, the grammar readme-readback.sh and promote-latest.mjs (REGISTRY_WINDOW) already share. release.yml was deliberately left out of that branch.

NOT MEASURED. What follows is the inference of the reviewer, not a measurement. With abc the window would be 0 seconds, so a lagging package would get a warning annotation and a green step, without its dist.shasum check. With 30m the step would fail and put a red X on a good release. The step runs after the publish, so it gates no publish either way. The runner is ubuntu-latest with its own shell version, not the macOS 3.2 shell LCLI-629 measured, so those measurements do not transfer and have to be re-taken.

As a release.yml change it needs its own reviewer pass before it lands (repository rule: anything touching release.yml or scripts/ gets a reviewer).

acceptanceCriteria.text: The behaviour of the release.yml visibility wait on a malformed vars.REGISTRY_WINDOW_SECONDS (at least abc, 30m, 08 and empty) is measured on the runner shell, and recorded here before any fix
The step refuses a value outside the REGISTRY_WINDOW grammar before it waits, naming the variable and showing the value escaped, and a test pins that its pattern equals REGISTRY_WINDOW.source
bun test and bun run lint:shell exit 0; a reviewer pass covers the release.yml change

plan: 1. Measure first (AC1): extract the release.yml visibility-wait step and run its actual lines with REGISTRY_WINDOW_SECONDS set to abc, 30m, 08 and empty in an ubuntu:24.04 container bash via docker, recording bash --version. Record the table on this task before any fix.

2. Fix (AC2): inside the step, before the wait, refuse any value outside the REGISTRY_WINDOW grammar shared with publish-release.sh, readme-readback.sh and promote-latest.mjs, naming REGISTRY_WINDOW_SECONDS and printing the value escaped, in the publish-release.sh refusal style.

3. Test: new test/lcli630-release-window-guard.test.ts pins that the release.yml pattern equals the imported REGISTRY_WINDOW.source, and runs the extracted step to prove a malformed value is refused and a valid one accepted.

4. Gates: bun test, bun run lint, bun run lint:shell, actionlint on release.yml, bun run lore check from source. Open a PR to dev titled fix(LCLI-630), note measurement, gates and PR here. Reviewer pass (AC3) is the dispatcher's; do not complete.
